segments.title: Siri remembers your chats now
segments.say: Siri can now remember what you talked about before.

segments.title: New in iOS 27.2
segments.say: With iOS twenty-seven point two, you can ask Siri about something it told you before.

segments.text: What did you recommend last week?

segments.title: It can use more
segments.say: It can also use photos in Messages, calendar attendees, and your voicemails.

segments.title: You pick the apps
segments.say: A new setting, Excluded Apps, lets you choose which apps Siri can access.
Save this before you update, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
